cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our team.
In this role, you will code and debug real-time embedded firmware for our new generation of electric motor controllers/inverters. If you enjoy working in a HW/SW lab environment, this may be the job for you.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Write effective and efficient real-time software.
Work within a small, highly skilled design team to complete assigned objectives.
Follow software development cycles, including software requirements capture and verification of software to these requirements.
Design, setup and run tests to ensure the design meets specifications.
Debug systems.
Provide support to continuation engineering and other [Company name masked] engineering teams.
Participate in the preparation of development specifications.
Collaborate with [Company name masked] engineering sites around the world.
Work on a wide variety of vehicles we support, including golf cars, forklifts, small on-road cars, electric ride-on lawnmowers, etc.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree with industry experience or closely related academic or personal projects in embedded, real-time software.
User of emulators, in-circuit testing and software debugging tools/techniques.
Experience with serial communication protocols using CAN, for example CANopen, J1939, UDS, etc.
Knowledge of real-time operating systems and task schedulers.
Knowledge of electronic circuits and implementation.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of control and feedback systems for power and motor control.
Experience with Unified Modeling Language (UML), C++, unit testing.
Excellent interpersonal skills.

In this role, you will code and debug real-time embedded firmware for our new generation of electric motor controllers/inverters. If you enjoy working in a HW/SW lab environment, this may be the job for you.
cond_0137.responsibilities:
What you'll do:
Write effective and efficient real-time software.
Work within a small, highly skilled design team to complete assigned objectives.
Follow software development cycles, including software requirements capture and verification of software to these requirements.
Design, setup and run tests to ensure the design meets specifications.
Debug systems.
Provide support to continuation engineering and other [Company name masked] engineering teams.
Participate in the preparation of development specifications.
Collaborate with [Company name masked] engineering sites around the world.
Work on a wide variety of vehicles we support, including golf cars, forklifts, small on-road cars, electric ride-on lawnmowers, etc.
cond_0137.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Candidates should have substantial industry experience or closely related academic or personal projects in embedded, real-time software.
Demonstrated expertise with emulators, in-circuit testing, and software debugging tools/techniques.
Deep knowledge of serial communication protocols using CAN, for example CANopen, J1939, UDS, etc.
Advanced knowledge of control and feedback systems for power and motor control.
Advanced knowledge of real-time operating systems and task schedulers.
Advanced knowledge of electronic circuits and implementation.
Strong command of Unified Modeling Language (UML), C++, and unit testing.
Exceptional interpersonal skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
cond_0137.values: We value contributing in ways that are helpful, responsible, and considerate of others. We believe the quality of our work includes how well it serves people and how fairly it is carried out.
